findings.highlight: He said he doesn’t mind having you over at my place since I’m a teacher
findings.evidenceJa: 先生の家なら安心だ、ご指導よろしくお願いします
findings.governingReading: a teacher’s house is safe, and he asks me to look after and instruct you
findings.explanation: Zouken’s stated confidence and formal request are reduced to mere permission based on Taiga’s profession.

findings.highlight: I’ll get the guys at my place to buy some for you
findings.evidenceJa: うちの若いのに揃えさせておく
findings.governingReading: I will have the young one in our house obtain it for you
findings.explanation: Taiga’s singular euphemistic reference to Shirou becomes multiple unspecified men.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜の体は柔らかそう
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s body looks soft
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces imagined softness with an explicit judgment of sexual attractiveness.

findings.evidenceJa: 抱きしめたい
findings.governingReading: want to embrace her
findings.explanation: A desire for an embrace is generalized to sexualized touching.

findings.evidenceJa: ばか言ってんじゃないぞ、藤ねえー、とか
findings.governingReading: inactive semicolon-commented Shirou rebuke
findings.explanation: mirror moon’s classic unvoiced branch restores a commented-out Shirou line and its quiet continuation.

findings.highlight: she is trying to cover Fuji-nee’s mouth
findings.evidenceJa: 必死に藤ねえの口を押さえている
findings.governingReading: she is desperately holding Fuji-nee’s mouth shut
findings.explanation: Sakura’s desperate force and continuing success are weakened to an attempt.

findings.evidenceJa: 柱への衝突
findings.governingReading: a collision with the pillar
findings.explanation: The object Sakura strikes is changed, and intentional straight-line running into it is added.

findings.highlight: Was she that eager to get away?
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下に出ようとして柱にぶつかるほど慌ててたのか
findings.governingReading: was she so flustered that she hit a pillar merely trying to enter the hall?
findings.explanation: Sakura’s degree of fluster is replaced by a motive of eagerness to escape.

findings.evidenceJa: ふらふらと廊下に消えていく桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura disappears down the hall unsteadily
findings.explanation: The physical instability of Sakura’s departure is omitted.

findings.highlight: I bet Sakura-chan was even more embarrassed
findings.evidenceJa: 顔を真っ赤にした士郎、いつもより意地っぱりで可愛いし
findings.governingReading: red-faced Shirou is more stubborn and cuter than usual
findings.explanation: Taiga’s teasing appraisal of Shirou, which explains Sakura’s increased embarrassment, is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: これみよがしに溜息をつく
findings.governingReading: Fuji-nee sighs ostentatiously for me to notice
findings.explanation: The performative teasing quality of Taiga’s sigh disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: すっごくよろしくない
findings.governingReading: this feels extremely inauspicious
findings.explanation: Shirou’s exaggerated sense that Taiga’s reaction bodes badly is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 言いたい放題言って
findings.governingReading: after saying everything she pleases
findings.explanation: Taiga’s broader unchecked teasing is narrowed to the final instruction.

findings.evidenceJa: 客間の備品のチェック
findings.governingReading: check the guest-room supplies and equipment
findings.explanation: The practical inventory is narrowed to furniture.

findings.highlight: a guest room that isn’t normally used
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに使ってもらった部屋とは別の、長年使っていなかった客間
findings.governingReading: a different guest room from Saber’s, one unused for many years
findings.explanation: The comparison with Saber’s room and long disuse are omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: それを我が事のように喜んで
findings.governingReading: I rejoiced in her growth as though it were my own
findings.explanation: Shirou’s deeply personal happiness at Sakura’s development is reduced to a generic evaluation.

findings.highlight: I injured my shoulder, he complained about the burn
findings.evidenceJa: バイト先で肩を痛めて、火傷の跡がどうこうという話になって
findings.governingReading: I hurt my shoulder at work, and the subject of my burn scar came up
findings.explanation: The workplace setting is omitted and a nonexistent male complainant is invented.

findings.highlight: She waited for me in front of my house one day
findings.evidenceJa: うちの前で俺の帰りをずっと待っていて
findings.governingReading: she waited continuously in front of my house for me to return
findings.explanation: The sustained wait is weakened and an unsupported isolated day is added.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜の体は柔らかそう
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s body looks soft
findings.explanation: The mature branch repeats the substitution of explicit sexiness for imagined softness.

findings.evidenceJa: 抱きしめたい
findings.governingReading: want to embrace her
findings.explanation: The desire to embrace Sakura is again generalized to touching.

findings.highlight: She was always just my underclassman
findings.evidenceJa: つい最近まで、桜は純粋に後輩だった
findings.governingReading: until very recently Sakura had purely been my underclassman
findings.explanation: A recently ended perception is changed into an unbounded lifelong one.

findings.evidenceJa: 胸がおかしくなる
findings.governingReading: my chest feels strange
findings.explanation: A bodily-emotional disturbance is recast as mental instability.

findings.highlight: she has more places to wash
findings.evidenceJa: カラスの行水ってワケにもいかな
findings.governingReading: she cannot exactly take a crow’s bath—a hasty dip—either
findings.explanation: The comic idiom about Shirou’s own very short baths is omitted, leaving the thought incomplete.

findings.highlight: I believe it was not caused by fatigue
findings.evidenceJa: 先ほどの衝突は疲れからではなく、純粋に目測を誤ったものと感じました
findings.governingReading: I believe the collision came not from fatigue but from a simple error in judging distance
findings.explanation: Saber’s positive alternative diagnosis—misjudged distance—is omitted.
